  - Card/panel surface: bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-900 to-neutral-950, with shadow-inner tint acceptable via bg-neutral-900/95.
  - Inset/recessed surface (fader tracks, displays, waveform beds, track table): bg-gradient-to-b from-black to-neutral-900/80, base bg-black/70.
  - Knob/pad cap surface: bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-700 to-neutral-900.

- Borders & radius:
  - Panels: border border-amber-500/15 rounded-2xl.
  - Insets/displays/waveform beds: border border-amber-500/10 rounded-xl.
  - Inputs (search, selects): border border-neutral-700/60 rounded-lg.
  - Buttons: border border-amber-500/25 rounded-lg.
  - Chips / hot-cue pads / toggles: border border-amber-500/20 rounded-md.
  - Knobs (circular): border border-amber-500/20 rounded-full.
  - Fader thumbs: border border-amber-400/40 rounded-md.
  - NEVER use white borders; all borders are amber, neutral, teal or violet at low opacity.

- Color palette:
  - Primary text: text-amber-50.
  - Secondary text: text-neutral-300.
  - Muted/disabled text: text-neutral-500.
  - Primary accent fill: bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-400 to-orange-600 (with text-neutral-950 on it).
  - Accent text: text-amber-400. Accent border: border-amber-500/40.
  - Secondary signal accent (cue/routing/active meters mid): text-teal-300 / bg-teal-500/80 / border-teal-400/40.
  - Tertiary routing accent (deck-B routing, FX-on states): text-violet-300 / bg-violet-500/70 / border-violet-400/40.
  - Success: text-emerald-400 / bg-emerald-500/80.
  - Warning: text-amber-400 / bg-amber-500/80.
  - Danger: text-rose-400 / bg-rose-500/80.
  - VU meter gradient (fills): from-emerald-500 via-amber-400 to-rose-500.
  - Deck A visual identity accent: amber/orange. Deck B visual identity accent: teal/cyan (use these to color-code lanes, pads, faders per deck).

  - Body: text-sm font-normal tracking-normal leading-snug text-neutral-300.
  - Labels (knob/fader/control captions): text-[11px] font-medium tracking-widest uppercase leading-none text-neutral-400.
  - Captions (meta, secondary info): text-[10px] font-normal tracking-wide leading-none text-neutral-500.

  - Card/panel padding: p-3.
  - Compact item padding (chips, pads, list rows, knob clusters): p-2, or px-2 py-1 for text buttons/rows.
  - Small internal gaps: gap-2.

library.description: Circular platter surface; dragging rotates it, emitting angular delta in normalized rotations per drag step and a scrub velocity (1 = nominal play speed). rotation is the current platter angle in degrees; spinning reflects playback motion.
Momentary press button; fires onPress on each press. Face content supplied by the component.
Latching button that holds an on/off state; clicking flips it and reports the new boolean.
Sliding two-position switch; reports the new boolean state on flip.
Linear travel control, vertical or horizontal; drag maps position to a value within min..max, optionally snapping to the supplied detents. Reports the absolute value.
Rotary control; vertical/circular drag maps to a value within min..max, either continuous or snapped to the listed steps. Reports the absolute value in the unit defined by min/max.
Passive alphanumeric display of a single supplied value (text or number) in its own unit; shows nothing but the value it is given.
Square performance pad; fires onPress when struck, and reports a long/alternate press separately when provided. 'armed' marks that a cue point is stored on it.
Segmented level indicator showing a normalized 0-1 signal level, optionally with a 0-1 peak-hold marker; orientation selectable.

Dragging emits a seek position in seconds and a scrub velocity (1 = nominal play speed).

spec.name: DJ Table: Deck A (Left Player)
spec.genInstructions: Build the left-hand virtual turntable deck with a jog/platter wheel, transport controls, tempo fader, hot cues, loops and track metadata readouts so the DJ can play, cue, pitch-bend and beat-match the track loaded on channel A.
spec.role: The left playback engine that plays and manipulates one track, feeding its state to the shared waveform and receiving loads, mix levels and effects from the other components.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user clicks 'Load to Deck A' in the browser, the selected track's file, title, artist, BPM and key are sent to Deck A, which resets the platter to the start, loads the audio and populates its title/BPM/time displays.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
effectors.description: Deck A's audio output level is governed by the mixer: channel-A gain, 3-band EQ, channel-A volume fader and crossfader position continuously scale/shape Deck A's signal, and the mixer's cue button routes Deck A to the headphone bus.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When an effect is routed to Deck A and toggled on, the rack sends the effect type, dry/wet amount, beat-multiplier and parameter values to be applied to Deck A's audio in real time.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Waveform Display
effectors.description: When the user drags or scratches on the waveform lane assigned to Deck A, the resulting seek position/scrub velocity is sent to Deck A, which jumps the playhead or nudges playback speed accordingly.

targets.name: DJ Table: Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck A streams its current playback position, play/pause state, tempo/pitch value, BPM, loaded track waveform data and cue/loop points to the display, which renders and scrolls Deck A's upper waveform lane and beat grid in sync.

VISUAL GUIDELINES — "MOLTEN BRASS" DJ CONSOLE DESIGN SYSTEM (shared token sheet; apply verbatim, appearance only)

THEME: A premium studio DJ console rendered in deep charcoal-graphite with molten amber/tangerine accents, teal-cyan secondary signals and violet routing highlights. Warm, analog, high-end — NO neon blue/pink, NO white borders.

- Background layers:
  - Outermost container: bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-950 via-stone-950 to-black, with a subtle overlay tint of bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,rgba(251,146,60,0.06),transparent_60%)]. Base color fallback bg-neutral-950.
  - Card/panel surface: bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-900 to-neutral-950, with shadow-inner tint acceptable via bg-neutral-900/95.
  - Inset/recessed surface (fader tracks, displays, waveform beds, track table): bg-gradient-to-b from-black to-neutral-900/80, base bg-black/70.
  - Knob/pad cap surface: bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-700 to-neutral-900.

- Borders & radius:
  - Panels: border border-amber-500/15 rounded-2xl.
  - Insets/displays/waveform beds: border border-amber-500/10 rounded-xl.
  - Inputs (search, selects): border border-neutral-700/60 rounded-lg.
  - Buttons: border border-amber-500/25 rounded-lg.
  - Chips / hot-cue pads / toggles: border border-amber-500/20 rounded-md.
  - Knobs (circular): border border-amber-500/20 rounded-full.
  - Fader thumbs: border border-amber-400/40 rounded-md.
  - NEVER use white borders; all borders are amber, neutral, teal or violet at low opacity.

- Color palette:
  - Primary text: text-amber-50.
  - Secondary text: text-neutral-300.
  - Muted/disabled text: text-neutral-500.
  - Primary accent fill: bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-400 to-orange-600 (with text-neutral-950 on it).
  - Accent text: text-amber-400. Accent border: border-amber-500/40.
  - Secondary signal accent (cue/routing/active meters mid): text-teal-300 / bg-teal-500/80 / border-teal-400/40.
  - Tertiary routing accent (deck-B routing, FX-on states): text-violet-300 / bg-violet-500/70 / border-violet-400/40.
  - Success: text-emerald-400 / bg-emerald-500/80.
  - Warning: text-amber-400 / bg-amber-500/80.
  - Danger: text-rose-400 / bg-rose-500/80.
  - VU meter gradient (fills): from-emerald-500 via-amber-400 to-rose-500.
  - Deck A visual identity accent: amber/orange. Deck B visual identity accent: teal/cyan (use these to color-code lanes, pads, faders per deck).

- Typography:
  - Font family (UI/body): font-sans (Inter/system). Display/numeric family: font-mono for ALL numeric readouts, BPM, time, and button/pad labels.
  - Headings (panel section titles): text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide leading-tight text-amber-50.
  - Body: text-sm font-normal tracking-normal leading-snug text-neutral-300.
  - Labels (knob/fader/control captions): text-[11px] font-medium tracking-widest uppercase leading-none text-neutral-400.
  - Captions (meta, secondary info): text-[10px] font-normal tracking-wide leading-none text-neutral-500.
  - DISPLAY text (BPM, time elapsed/remaining, track title readouts, large numerals): font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-amber-300 with a subtle glow drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(251,146,60,0.35)]. No font-size — sized to fit.
  - Button/pad printed text: font-mono font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase, color inherits button state (text-neutral-950 on accent fills, text-amber-100 on dark).

- Spacing:
  - Inter-component gap: gap-3.
  - Card/panel padding: p-3.
  - Compact item padding (chips, pads, list rows, knob clusters): p-2, or px-2 py-1 for text buttons/rows.
  - Small internal gaps: gap-2.

- Structural chrome (only components that have a header/footer):
  - Header/title bar height: h-9. Appearance: px-3, bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-800/80 to-neutral-900, border-b border-amber-500/20. Title type: text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-amber-100 with a small text-amber-400 accent dot/glyph permitted.
  - Footer/status strip height: h-7. Appearance: px-3, bg-neutral-950/90, border-t border-amber-500/15. Status text: font-mono text-[10px] tracking-wide text-neutral-400; active status text-teal-300.

- Elevation & shadow:
  - Floating panels/cards: shadow-2xl shadow-black/60.
  - Raised interactive caps (knobs, pads, play button): shadow-lg shadow-black/50.
  - Flat/inset surfaces: shadow-inner shadow-black/70 (no drop shadow).
  - Active accent glow (playing platter, engaged FX, lit cue): shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(251,146,60,0.45)]; teal variant shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(45,212,191,0.4)]; violet variant shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(167,139,250,0.4)].
